items.title: Colorado Airports Receive $12.6M in State Aviation Grants
items.description: Colorado CDOT awarded $12.6 million in state and local aviation grants to 18 airports statewide — including nearby Northern Colorado Regional and Erie Municipal, both receiving pavement maintenance funding.

items.title: CDOT Aeronautics Division to Be Inducted into Colorado Aviation Hall of Fame
items.description: Colorado's CDOT Aeronautics Division is being honored at this year's Colorado Aviation Hall of Fame induction — a milestone for the division and the broader GA community it serves.

items.title: Firestone Art & Music Show
items.description: The annual Firestone Art & Music Show at Carbon Valley Regional Library — a showcase of Front Range regional creativity, just down the road from 18V.

items.title: LochbOOOie Spooktacular — Halloween in Lochbuie
items.description: Halloween fun with treats, music, and activities at Lochbuie Town Hall — a community favorite just a short drive from the airpark.

items.title: Fort Lupton Winterfest — Cookies & Cocoa with Santa
items.description: The Fort Lupton Public & School Library hosts the community's annual Winterfest — cookies, hot cocoa, and Santa on the calendar as the season turns.

items.title: Greeley Farmers Market — Saturdays Through October
items.description: Saturdays at the Greeley Farmers Market, about 20 minutes from 18V. Fresh local produce, vendors, and a great warm-weather tradition wrapping up for the season.
